request:
Read and follow the project documentation.

Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Sapspitter Beetle".

Creative brief
Name: Sapspitter Beetle
Collection: Briarwild Brood. Woodland animals reshaped by an ancient living forest, using thorns, seeds, roots, sap, and leaf-pattern projectiles.
Core concept: A slow ranged turret that creates temporary sticky zones.
Body and silhouette: Rounded beetle with a large shell, small head, six compact legs, and an upward-angled mouth nozzle.
Signature features: Transparent sap chamber, bark-textured shell plates, and two twig-like antennae.
Palette and materials: Walnut brown, honey amber, dark green, and glossy black.
Movement personality: Methodical, stubborn, and mechanically precise.
Attack concept: Fires three amber globules in a shallow spread; each glob leaves a small slowing patch before fading.
Directional details: A bite-shaped notch is missing from the rear-right shell edge.
Avoid: Metallic robot beetle, realistic insect anatomy, translucent details too subtle for 32 pixels.
